Privacy Policy

Last updated: June 17, 2026

At ALMAS Indian Cuisine, we are committed to protecting the privacy of our visitors and guests. This Privacy Policy outlines the types of personal information we collect, how we use it, and the security measures we take to protect your data.

1. Information We Collect

When you visit our website, register an account, make an online takeout order, or submit catering inquiries, we collect information including:

  • Personal Details: Name, email address, phone number, and fulfillment preferences.
  • Payment Information: Billing data processed securely via our payment gateway. We do not store credit card details directly on our servers; payments are processed securely by Square.
  • Usage Data: Information about how you navigate and interact with our web platform.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use the collected information for the following purposes:

  • To process, cook, and complete your takeout, delivery, or catering orders.
  • To email or text you receipts, purchase invoices, and order status updates.
  • To verify your account credentials (via Email/OTP or Google OAuth login).
  • To respond to your catering requests, table reservations, or contact submissions.

3. Third-Party Service Providers

We share data only with trusted third-party providers essential to running our business operations:

  • Payment Processing: All online payments are handled directly by Square. Square maintains strict PCI-DSS compliance standards.
  • Google OAuth: If you sign up using Google, we access name, email, and avatar profile data based on Google's sharing standards.

4. Data Security

We implement strict security standards, including SSL/HTTPS encryption, to protect your personal information during transmission. Access to your personal account data is restricted to authorized personnel who need to process your order.

5. Contact Us

If you have any questions or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy or your personal data, please contact us at:
